description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI`, responsible for validating URI attributes according to RFC 3986. It includes methods for constructing the class, creating URI objects, and validating URIs with various checks such as parsing, filtering, and scheme-specific validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI
classes.description: A class for validating URI attributes per RFC 3986, supporting scheme-specific validation, filtering, and context management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the URI validation object, optionally marking it as embedding a resource.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new URI validation object with the specified embedded resource flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a given URI string through parsing, filtering, scheme-specific validation, and contextual checks, returning the URI string if valid or false otherwise.
